source(output(
		BUSINESS_UNIT as string,
		CUST_ID as string,
		ITEM as string,
		CA_ITEM_DTL_LN_NUM as string,
		DUE_DT as string,
		CA_COVERAGE_FRM_DT as string,
		CA_COVERAGE_TO_DT as string,
		CA_LINE_OF_BUS as string,
		CA_PRODUCT_ID as string,
		FISCAL_YEAR as string,
		ACCOUNTING_PERIOD as string,
		ORIGIN_ID as string,
		ENTRY_AMT as string,
		JOURNAL_ID as string,
		JOURNAL_DATE as string,
		BUSINESS_UNIT_GL as string,
		OPERATING_UNIT as string,
		ACCOUNT as string,
		CLASS_FLD as string,
		PROGRAM_CODE as string,
		CHARTFIELD2 as string,
		CHARTFIELD1 as string,
		AFFILIATE as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		FUND_CODE as string,
		CHARTFIELD3 as string,
		CREATE_DATE as string,
		ADD_DTTM as string,
		CA_PARENT_GRP_ID as string,
		BLEI_CK as string,
		PDBL_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FFSRCINBOUNDFILE
FFSRCINBOUNDFILE derive(INBOUND_SUMMARY_ID = $gv_BatchID,
		CLASS_FLD = iif(length(trim(CLASS_FLD)) == 0, toString(null()), CLASS_FLD),
		CHARTFIELD3 = iif(length(trim(CHARTFIELD3)) == 0, toString(null()), CHARTFIELD3),
		CA_LINE_OF_BUS = iif(length(trim(CA_LINE_OF_BUS)) == 0, toString(null()), CA_LINE_OF_BUS),
		CHARTFIELD2 = iif(length(trim(CHARTFIELD2)) == 0, toString(null()), CHARTFIELD2),
		CHARTFIELD1 = iif(length(trim(CHARTFIELD1)) == 0, toString(null()), CHARTFIELD1),
		CREATE_DATE = substring(toString((CREATE_DATE)), toInteger(1), toInteger(10)) + ' ' + substring(toString((CREATE_DATE)), toInteger(12), toInteger(8)),
		AFFILIATE = iif(length(trim(AFFILIATE)) == 0, toString(null()), AFFILIATE),
		ADD_DTTM = substring(toString((ADD_DTTM)), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '/' + substring(toString((ADD_DTTM)), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '/' + substring(toString((ADD_DTTM)), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))) ~> DCTRANSFORM
DCTRANSFORM sink(input(
		JOURNAL_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLASS_FLD as string,
		CUST_ID as string,
		DUE_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BUSINESS_UNIT_GL as string,
		ACCOUNT as string,
		ACCOUNTING_PERIOD as integer,
		PROGRAM_CODE as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		CA_ITEM_DTL_LN_NUM as integer,
		CA_LINE_OF_BUS as string,
		CA_PARENT_GRP_ID as string,
		ORIGIN_ID as string,
		ENTRY_AMT as integer,
		FUND_CODE as string,
		BLEI_CK as integer,
		OPERATING_UNIT as string,
		AFFILIATE as string,
		CA_PRODUCT_ID as string,
		BUSINESS_UNIT as string,
		JOURNAL_ID as string,
		CHARTFIELD3 as string,
		ITEM as string,
		CHARTFIELD2 as string,
		CHARTFIELD1 as string,
		CREATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CA_COVERAGE_FRM_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FISCAL_YEAR as integer,
		CA_COVERAGE_TO_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PDBL_ID as string,
		INBOUND_SUMMARY_ID as string,
		ADD_DTTM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		JOURNAL_DATE,
		CLASS_FLD,
		CUST_ID,
		DUE_DT,
		BUSINESS_UNIT_GL,
		ACCOUNT,
		ACCOUNTING_PERIOD,
		PROGRAM_CODE,
		PRODUCT,
		CA_ITEM_DTL_LN_NUM,
		CA_LINE_OF_BUS,
		CA_PARENT_GRP_ID,
		ORIGIN_ID,
		ENTRY_AMT,
		FUND_CODE,
		BLEI_CK,
		OPERATING_UNIT,
		AFFILIATE,
		CA_PRODUCT_ID,
		BUSINESS_UNIT,
		JOURNAL_ID,
		CHARTFIELD3,
		ITEM,
		CHARTFIELD2,
		CHARTFIELD1,
		CREATE_DATE,
		CA_COVERAGE_FRM_DT,
		FISCAL_YEAR,
		CA_COVERAGE_TO_DT,
		PDBL_ID,
		INBOUND_SUMMARY_ID,
		ADD_DTTM)) ~> OLEDBDESTINBOUNDTABLE
